value.rationale: The endpoint edge-TV time-derivative response of branching diffusion has two sharp structural degree thresholds: local rebound starts at degree four and the secondary peak exceeds unit gain starting exactly at nine leaves, while increasing to 2. This natural sharp full-family stability diagnostic is distinct from the previously studied norm of the heat evolution and is attained by explicit one-edge data; it is not a tiny numerical improvement or an unmotivated finite slice.
